document.abstract: Intensity, color, and directivity are important factors in the proper design of television studio-lighting facilities. Good color response can be attained with image-orthicon tubes using a combination of fluorescent and incandescent lights, together with simple filters on the camera lens. The characteristics of these lamps and filters are presented along with means of estimating power requirements for various sizes of studios.
